fusions.name: Pond Ripple
fusions.desc: Strikes the ground and a ripple deals 3 water damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave each [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Seven Skips
fusions.desc: Skims the hammer at a target up to 8 tiles away for 28 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach. It ignores the target's resistances.

fusions.name: Rain on the Anvil
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Bobs Back Up
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything other than fire, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
